meta.notes: Physical aggression: any forceful contact toward another person with hand, foot, or object. Self-injury: contact of hand or object to own head with audible sound. Mand for break: independent exchange of the break card. Waits 2 min after mand: scored as independent out of opportunities presented. Tantrum: each episode logged with its start and stop time or its length; the daily total is their sum. Frequency recorded across the 6-hour instructional day.

behaviors.name: Physical aggression
behaviors.definition: Any forceful contact toward another person with hand, foot, or object, including attempts that do not make contact.

behaviors.name: Self-injury
behaviors.definition: Contact of hand or object to own head with audible sound.

behaviors.name: Property destruction
behaviors.definition: Throwing, tearing, or striking materials or furniture with enough force to displace or damage them.

behaviors.name: Mand for break (card exchange)
behaviors.definition: Independent exchange of the break card with an adult, with no vocal or gestural prompt in the preceding 10 seconds.

behaviors.name: Tantrum (duration)
behaviors.definition: Crying, screaming, or dropping to the floor lasting 10 seconds or more. Begins at the first instance; ends after 30 seconds with none.

behaviors.name: Waits 2 min after mand
behaviors.definition: After a mand for break is honored with a wait signal, remains within the work area without target behavior for 2 minutes. Scored out of opportunities presented.
